LOCAL VIDEO / ANIMATED IMAGE · NO PLAYBACK

Analyze a file

Decode a local video or animated image (GIF, APNG, animated WebP or AVIF) frame by frame and screen it for SC 2.3.1 and SC 2.3.2. Nothing is played or shown. Frames are drawn to an undisplayed canvas. The file stays in this browser.

Screening only. This analyzes the file's decoded frames, not the page that shows it. Page layout, the player, captions, overlays, playback rate and the displayed size are not part of the file. Test the page with the capture tool as well, and give the displayed size below to measure area.

Use at least the video's own frame rate. Frames shorter than one sample interval can be skipped.

The other model is also run and reported when it would differ.

Use the page background behind the image. Transparent animations can flash differently on other backgrounds.

Optional area calibration

The size the content is shown at on the page, at standard zoom. The aspect ratio must match the file within 2%. Test the largest presentation, including fullscreen.
